scope: Verified bounded desktop record viewer MVP; synthetic production-store databases, actual Windows UI and packaged CLI. Not a recording or real-installer trial.

build_commands: dotnet publish desktop/Contain.Viewer/Contain.Viewer.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o target/viewer-publish
package.clean_windows_10_11_manual_validation: not_run; native launch and UI checks were on the recorded Windows Server CI runner
package.scope: Existing-record desktop viewing only, synthetic production databases and real packaged CLI. No ETW or installer capture.

native.screenshot_method: Actual production WinForms controls rendered by Windows DrawToBitmap after real button/selection actions; synthetic data only.
native.report_scope: Actual locally exported HTML from synthetic model data; public byte-identical copy only after reviewed-path checks. No user database or full CLI diagnostic log published.
native.time_precision: JSON string FILETIME and unrounded raw integer tokens; no JavaScript Number conversion.

quality.desktop_acceptance: Separate native integration and package manifests determine desktop acceptance; quality alone is insufficient.

affected_function_assessment.summary_counts: Main executed record covered 49/49 code regions; predicate closure 2/2. This is not a branch-coverage claim.
affected_function_assessment.open_read_only: Main executed record covered 58/70 regions. Unexecuted regions include SQLite open/busy timeout/schema prepare/in-memory backup/migration and read-transaction setup error propagation; the contextual open-error closure also has zero execution.
affected_function_assessment.list_details: Main executed record 11/13 regions; row conversion closure 12/17. SQL prepare/query iteration and per-column conversion error propagation remain unexecuted.
affected_function_assessment.events_page_compatible: Main executed record 36/39 regions; SQLite query/stream-state/full legacy load error propagation remains unexecuted.
affected_function_assessment.aliases: All raw instance records including zero-count instantiations and offline aliases are retained. No merged unique-source percentage is invented.

quality.scope: Windows Rust unit/quality execution. Shared production tests execute again in contain-offline; stable coverage includes inline tests. LLVM branch denominator is zero. .NET coverage was not measured; actual native UI integration and overall CI results are reported separately. No ETW acceptance is inferred.

not_run: New ETW capture (zero planned and executed)
Old 66-command integration because its doctor actively probes ETW; required read-only views exercised through the native viewer instead
Snapshot fallback integration (outside existing-record desktop scope)
